36304ab9-0687-4aeb-ba2f-735099eba381.job_description:
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications.

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain applications using Python, Java, or C++.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
Design and consume REST APIs.
Work with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Debug and resolve software issues.
Write unit tests and perform basic application testing.
Use Git and GitHub for version control.
Collaborate with other developers and team members.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.
Learn new technologies and follow software development best practices.

Required Skills:

Good understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming.
Knowledge of Python, Java, or C++.
Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of REST APIs and HTTP methods.
Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle and testing.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
36304ab9-0687-4aeb-ba2f-735099eba381.experience_requirements: The role expects an entry‑level candidate with a solid grasp of programming fundamentals and basic experience in Python, Java, or C++.
